analysis: Low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) is generally preferred over unfractionated heparin and other anticoagulants for the prophylaxis of venous thromboembolism (VTE) in patients undergoing cancer surgery. LMWH has been shown to be effective in reducing the risk of VTE in these patients, with a better safety profile, particularly in terms of lower risk of bleeding and better ease of use compared to alternatives like warfarin and unfractionated heparin.
